title: Black Friday Marketing Ideas to Boost Sales with Personalized Products
summary: Discover some Black Friday ideas and decide what personalized products you can offer on your online store to profit from this big shopping event.
body_markdown:
Black Friday is the biggest shopping event of the year, and 2026 is no exception: the date lands on **November 27, 2026** . Last year alone, US shoppers spent a record **$11.8 billion online on Black Friday** , up 9.1% from the year before, while **202.9 million Americans** shopped across the five days from Thanksgiving through Cyber Monday, the highest total on record. To capture a share of that, businesses need more than just discounts: they need smart Black Friday marketing strategies that align with customer demand, online shopping trends, and personalization.


## Understanding Black Friday Consumer Behavior


Understanding consumer behavior (what they buy, how they shop, and the deals that attract them) is essential for retailers to maximize sales during this busy shopping season.


To fully capitalize on Black Friday, it is not just about offering discounts, but strategically thinking of the best Black Friday ideas and selecting the products that align with market trends and customer demand.


Retailers must be prepared to highlight high-demand items, from electronics and fashion to home goods and toys, with attractive deals that can draw in both online and in-store shoppers.


Understanding how people shop is key, as many consumers now rely on online platforms, mobile devices, and social media to find deals, compare prices, and make purchases. Mobile has officially taken the lead too: **over 52% of online holiday sales now happen on mobile** , ahead of desktop for the first time. As such, having a well-rounded digital strategy, from email marketing and social media campaigns to website optimization, is critical to capturing customer interest.


In this competitive environment, knowing consumer preferences and behaviors can give businesses an edge. Offering personalized experiences, exclusive early access to loyal customers, and limited-time promotions can further incentivize shoppers to choose your store over competitors.


Black Friday isn't just a one-day event. It sets the tone for the holiday season and offers businesses the chance to attract new customers, boost sales, and strengthen loyalty.


## **What do people shop the most on Black Friday?**


During Black Friday, people often shop for a wide range of items, with some categories consistently standing out due to major discounts. Among the most popular items, we can find electronics and home appliances, fashion and apparel, toys, beauty and skincare, furniture and home goods, fitness equipment, video games, and subscription services. Electronics also tend to see the deepest discounts, often averaging around 30% off.

## **How to announce Black Friday deals**


To guarantee successful sales, you should not only focus on what you offer but also on how you offer it.


- **Create a sense of urgency:** Promote limited-time deals and offer exclusive personalized options just for Black Friday.
- **Bundle deals:** Offer special discounts when customers buy multiple personalized items or create gift bundles.
- **Highlight unique offerings:** Use targeted marketing to showcase how personalized products make great gifts.
